notes: Alaska has a smaller population distributed across a vast geographic area, resulting in fewer animal welfare organizations compared to more densely populated states. Collection includes shelters and rescues from major population centers (Anchorage, Fairbanks, Juneau), regional hubs (Mat-Su Valley, Kenai Peninsula, Kodiak), and Southeast Alaska communities (Sitka, Ketchikan). Also includes organizations serving rural and remote areas which face unique challenges in animal welfare due to geographic isolation.
